Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this exciting game. With the series locked 1-1, the remaining matches promise to be even more exciting. The 4th ODI is on 29th October at the Brabourne Stadium, Mumbai. Do join us at 1330 local (0800 GMT) for all the action. Cheers!

Victorious Windies captain, Jason Holder credits his boys for playing an outstanding game of cricket and is really pleased that they hung in there nicely. Reckons his partnership with Hope was important and admits that he should have stayed there longer. Adds that they knew India were a batter short and if they remove Dhoni early, they will get into the lower order. On his spinners, Holder says that Nurse was outstanding and it's good to see him taking crucial wickets and also adding vital runs. Feels that not much has changed and the guys are just learning and thriving to become consistent. Mentions that being consistent is the key to winning matches.

Man of the Match, Ashley Nurse says that it turned out to be his day and he played with a lot of free spirit. Adds that when Shai Hope got out, he decided to take on the bowlers as the score wasn't too big then. Also mentions that he backs his strengths. Signs off by dedicating his wickets to his friend, Sunny Sohail whom he met in the CPL.

India's skipper, Virat Kohli says that they bowled pretty well as the wicket wasn't offering much in the first 35 overs. Terms the bowling performance as very professional and admits that they should have closed it well in the last 10 overs. Feels they should have been chasing 250-260. States that the target was pretty much gettable but they didn't get the partnerships going. Credits Windies for playing better cricket and believes they deserved to win. On team combinations, Kohli replies when both Kedar and Pandya are playing they get an extra batsman/bowler option which gives them the depth. Mentions it's difficult to get the balance right without them. On his batting, Kohli states that he doesn't want to talk about it much and it's a bit embarrassing when people ask him the same thing again and again. On his dismissal, the Indian skipper tells that he wanted to go after Samuels but failed to execute the shot well. Adds that they need to take wins and losses in their stride and they are looking forward to the challenge in Mumbai.

Marlon Samuels smiles and says that he has been bowling in the nets and they have been training as a unit, getting stronger and stronger. Praises Shai Hope and counts him one for the future. Adds that Hetmyer has a fearless approach and he is pleased with his progress. Considers it as a very important victory and says that going into the next game 1-1 is better than 2-0. Further says that they will take the next match even more seriously and will look to improve in all departments. States that they are looking to win and not only compete.

Shai Hope and Marlon Samuels are giving a quick interview to Sanjay Manjrekar. The former says that he is pleased with his consistency with the bat and credits the team for this win. Mentions that they lost a few quick wickets and he wanted to bat through the innings. Adds that he has not changed much in his game and his preparation is still the same.

Windies were excellent with their intensity in the field. They felt the pressure initially when Kohli and Dhawan were going strong. But the tourists never lost hope. They managed to pick wickets at regular intervals which kept them very much in the game. It can be considered as a masterstroke by Jason Holder to give the ball to Marlon Samuels who earned them the wicket of the danger man, Virat Kohli. He finished with three wickets while Ashley Nurse, Obed McCoy and Holder bagged two wickets apiece.

India's vulnerable point (middle order) was touched and exposed today. Chasing a stiff target, they lost Rohit Sharma early. Then, Virat Kohli and Shikhar Dhawan put together a 79-run stand which was followed by a few more partnerships involving the Indian skipper. Kohli held one end tightly and went on to notch up yet another century. However, the rest of the batting unit failed to give him enough support. Eventually, Marlon Samuels managed to pick the prized scalp of Kohli and the writing was on the wall for the Men in Blue. Still, they managed to drag it for a few overs, although the result was pretty much inevitable.

A magnificent victory for Windies! They were competitive in the first ODI, came close in the second and now have finally crossed the hurdle in the third attempt. Mind you, they have beaten India in spite of the home team having their first-choice bowling attack and more importantly, Virat Kohli scoring a century. Credit should be given to them. They deserve to be on level terms.

OUT! WINDIES WIN BY 43 RUNS! Samuels gets his third and is all smiles. A short delivery outside off, Bumrah goes back with the square cut but gets a thick outside edge. It brushes the keeper's gloves and lobs towards Holder at first slip. The Windies skipper makes no mistake and the series is now levelled 1-1!
Short and outside off, cut through cover-point for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, Yadav chips it over the bowler's head but denies the run.
Advances down the track and drives it through mid off for a single.
Bumrah chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Yorker on middle, Bumrah keeps it out safely.
Fuller and on middle, forced down to long on for one.
Wide! Slips one down the leg side, Kuldeep fails to flick.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short delivery on off, a mistimed pull shot to mid-wicket.
Bumrah in.

OUT! Khaleel is gone as well. Flatter and wider outside off, skidding through, Khaleel jumps out of the crease and tries to heave across the line. Fails to make any connection and Shai Hope is quick to dislodge the bails. He appeals and it's referred upstairs. The replays roll in they find Khaleel well short.
Stumping appeal is referred upstairs. Looks out.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, heaved over the leg side with the spin. It goes to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.

Not out and the crowd is making noise. They still have hope. A flighted ball around off, skidding back in, Kuldeep kneels for the sweep shot but seems to have missed it completely. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the umpire thinks a bit before raising his finger. Yadav refers it and the Ultra Edge finds a little spike when the ball is going past Kuldeep's gloves.
Given out lbw. Kuldeep has referred it...
FOUR! Quicker and shorter outside off, Yadav gets it away off the outer half of his bat as he attempts the late cut. It speeds away to the third man fence.
Short and outside off, Kuldeep ramps it down to third man for a run.

Mix-up but no harm done. Roach fires in a very full ball on middle, Khaleel hits it down to long on and they cross for a run. Turns for another run but Kuldeep sends him back. The throw comes in at the wrong end which is the striker's end and hence Ahmed survives.
Shortish and outside off, Yadav runs it down to third man for a run.
Goes for the yorker but ends up slipping a low full toss, Khaleel does well to help it through square leg for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, Khaleel jumps on the back foot and taps it down to point.
A full toss first up in this over, Kuldeep turns it on the leg side for a run.
MAIDEN! Loopy and outside off, Khaleel tries reverse sweeping but fails to connect.
Turning back into the batsman from outside off, some extra bounce, Ahmed defends it with some discomfort to the leg side.
Beaten again! Flatter and quicker outside off, Khaleel tries to cut but misses.
Flighted outside off, Ahmed pushes inside the line and misses.
Around off, Khaleel initially shapes up to go hard at it but then taps it down on the off side.
A touch short and on off, Khaleel plays it down to mid-wicket.
Khaleel Ahmed is the new batsman. 59 off 42 balls.

OUT! Chahal is gone! Roach digs in another short delivery, right at the body of the batsman. Chahal turns inside the crease with his pull shot but gets a big fat top edge. It flies down to fine leg and Keemo Paul (sub) sprints across to his right, covers good ground and takes a fine catch. End is nigh for India.
Back of a length delivery on off, Chahal stays back and defends it down.
Another short ball and Chahal has pulled it nicely over mid-wicket for a brace.
Short and on off, pulled across the line, not in much control and it flies towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.

Almost a run out! A length ball outside off, Kuldeep flat-bats it towards cover-point and Chahal comes running in looking for a run. He is sent back as the fielder throws it towards the bowler. Roach fails to collect it and Chahal survives.
Short and wide outside off, Chahal tries to cut but gets an outside edge. It rolls in front of short third man.
Tossed up ball around leg, Kuldeep works it off his pads to square leg.
Flatter and shorter on middle, it's punched off the back foot to long on for a run.
Yuzvendra Chahal is in next.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Game, set and match? Surely right? Master stroke by Holder. Marlon Samuels has not bowled often. He is brought into the attack and he gets the man on whose India's hopes were pinned. Samuels bowls it flatter and on middle, it is slightly shorter in length. Virat Kohli goes back to pull but the ball stays a touch low. Sneaks under the bat, takes a bit of an inside edge and uproots the stumps behind. The Windies are ecstatic and there is pin-drop silence in the stadium here. Kohli can't believe it as he walks back dejected and disgusted. India need another 64 in 51.
Slower through the air on middle, Kuldeep works it around the corner and gives the strike over to his skipper.
Flatter and outside off, Kohli hits it down to long on for a run.
Marlon Samuels is into the attack.
Short in length and wide outside off, Kuldeep watchfully lets it go to the keeper.
A touch short in length delivery on middle, Kohli taps it down in the gap on the leg side and rotates the strike.
Full and angling into the batsman, Yadav walks across the flicks it nicely through mid-wicket for a run.

In the air...in the air...falls safely. A miscued shot from the Indian skipper. He probably was eyeing to flick it over mid-wicket but ends up spooning it in the air towards long on. Doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep and they take a run.
Kuldeep Yadav is the new batsman.

OUT! Straight into the hands of the sweeper cover fielder. Hit it too well, Kumar. McCoy tempts the batsman by providing extra width outside off, Bhuvneshwar latches onto it and smacks it through the line. Fails to keep it down and Rovman Powell in the deep makes no mistake. This match is becoming very interesting now. 69 needed off 58 balls.
A low full toss outside off, Kumar fails to put it away and pushes it straight towards mid off.

Powerplay 2 signalled. Windies can now employ five fielders outside the ring till the end of this match. A bowling change also. Obed McCoy is back on. He has been a little expensive in the first couple of spells. Will he redeem himself?
Shortish and on middle, Kumar moves inside the line of the delivery and helps it to fine leg for a run.
Kumar is taking his chances. Another short delivery and Bhuvi swings his bat across the line. The top edge flies behind and they collect a couple before the fine leg fielder mops it up.
Bouncer this time, Kumar ducks.
Shortish and on middle, defended off the back foot to the leg side.

FOUR! Runs from Kumar's bat will be an added bonus for India. Holder serves it on a length and outside off, Kumar makes room and goes hard at it. Fails to middle his shot but still manages to get enough wood behind it as he drills it down the ground. Hemraj from mid on dives over the ball and lets it through for a boundary.
A length delivery on middle and leg, Kohli walks across the stumps and works it off the inner half of his bat to fine leg for a run. He is disappointed as he failed to put that away.
Bouncer, Kumar ducks underneath it with ease. 77 needed off 66 balls.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Short and outside off, hammered towards wide mid off where Nurse made an excellent diving stop. Saved three runs.
Full toss outside off, Kumar plays a good cover drive but fails to beat the fielder. Nice stop inside the ring. They take a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Slower one to outfox the number one batsman. Kohli is early into the pull shot and hence gets a bottom edge behind. Goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Shortish and outside off, pushed out to covers.
Good length delivery on off, defended off the back foot.
Outside off, dabbed down to third man for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Century number 38 for Virat Kohli! Three in a row for him. He is also the first Indian to do so. Champion. Relentless. Ruthless. Reaches there by pulling a short delivery down to fine leg for a run. The stadium erupts. But a subdued celebration by the Indian skipper. He knows that the job is not done yet. His team is in a spot of bother and he needs to stay till the end.
Short in length and just outside off, Virat swivels inside the crease and pulls it with nice timing through square leg. Takes a single and retains strike.
Rising delivery, an effort ball by Roach. It's on middle and Kumar somehow fends it off on the leg side. Kohli calls his partner quickly through for a run.
Back of a length delivery on off, it's tapped down from the crease to point.
Kohli opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Great shot! A slightly overpitched delivery outside off, Kohli picks it up and smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. The Indian skipper has to do the bulk of the scoring from hereon.
Lands it on a length outside off, Kohli leans forward and pushes it to covers.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.

Drinks break. The fall of last wicket has thrown this match wide open. Virat Kohli is now left with the lower order batsmen and will have to see India home. The chase master has done it in the past and can still do it. But the tourists will feel that if they manage to remove the Indian skipper now, they can level the series. Game on. Bhuvneshwar Kumar is the new batsman.

OUT! Dhoni falls and there is a stunned silence in the stadium! Holder with the breakthrough and he is ecstatic. He bowls a gentle delivery in the channel outside off. Dhoni's intention was to run it down to third man but gets a thick outside edge in the process. Shai Hope makes no mistake and Windies will feel that they are in with a chance now. 90 needed off 85 balls.
Back of a length delivery on off, Virat stays back and glides it to third man for a single.
On the pads, Dhoni has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Digs in a short ball on middle, Kohli pulls it this time to deep square leg for a run.
Shortish and on middle, played down to mid-wicket. Dhoni showed interest in a run but was sent back.
Jason Holder is back on as well.
Width on offer outside off, Kohli runs it down to third man for a run. 7 from this over, 93 needed off 90 balls.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length and outside off, Dhoni pushes inside the line and gets it away to third man for a run.
Shortish again, on off, staying a bit low, MS pushes it to covers.
Shortish and outside off, Kohli cuts it off his back foot to point where the fielder dives to make a half stop. They take a run.
FOUR! Nicely done! Short and wide outside off, Kohli calmly waits for it inside the crease and then at the last moment he just ramps it down to third man for a boundary.
Kemar Roach returns.
Short and outside off, Dhoni moves back and slaps it t deep point for a couple.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Senses the charge from the batsman and bowls it flat and on leg. Dhoni clips it off his pads but finds square leg.
Skidding away from the batsman, Kohli taps it down towards short third man and steal a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, flicked on the leg side but not in the gap again.
Flighted and on middle, flicked straight to square leg.
Dhoni has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Deft! Tossed up ball around off, Kohli plays it very late wide of short third man and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Those wrists on display again. Allen delivers a full ball around leg, Kohli attacks it with all his might and whips it over mid-wicket for a powerful boundary.
Quicker and shorter on off, punched from the back foot but straight to covers.
Flatter on off, Kohli plays it down towards backward point.
Shortish on off, 91 kph, punched down to long off for a run.
Plants his front foot forward to a full ball around off and flicks it to mid-wicket. Dot ball to end the over.
Short and wide outside off, Dhoni cuts it off his back foot to deep point for one.
Full and flighted outside off, Kohli reaches out for it and drills his drive to long off for a run.
Flatter and shorter on middle, skidding away, Kohli goes deep inside the crease and punches it to mid-wicket.
Shortish and on off, Dhoni goes on the back foot and punches it through cover-point for a run.
MS Dhoni comes to the centre amidst a big roar from the crowd. Last recognized batting pair in the middle for India.

OUT! GONE! There is a slight deflection. Pant has to go. A delivery sliding down the leg side, it's full in length and Pant shapes up for the paddle sweep. He fails to middle his shot and as soon as Shai Hope collects the ball, he puts in an appeal. The umpire shakes his head and seeing his keeper very sure, Holder goes for the DRS. The replays roll in and Ultra Edge finds a slight spike when the ball goes past Pant's gloves. Rishabh is given the walking order. India have lost their fourth wicket now. 112 needed off 113 balls.
Appeal for a caught behind. Not given and Windies have taken a review...
Flatter and quicker outside off, punched from the crease but straight to covers.
Shortish and outside off, tapped down to short third man.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Quicker on off, defended off the back foot.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Short in length and outside off, Kohli stands back and hammers it to wide long off for a boundary.

Run out chance missed! Tossed up ball on middle, Kohli works it ion front of square leg and sets off for a run. Slight hesitation shown by Pant but they eventually cross. The fielder releases his ball at the bowler's end but Nurse fumbles while collecting it. Had it collected it cleanly, Kohli could have been in danger.
Quicker ball on the pads, helped to short fine leg.
Short delivery, punched down to long on for a run.
Flighted and full on off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Goes back and punches it through covers for a run.

In the air... safe! Quicker delivery, short and outside off, Kohli rocks back to play the square cut but fails to keep it down. It goes on one bounce to short third man. Heart in mouth stuff for the Indian skipper.
Tossed up ball outside off, Kohli drives but finds covers.
Flatter on off, Pant forces it off his back foot through mid-wicket for a run.

Direct hit would have been interested. Tossed up ball on middle, Pant helps it towards short fine leg and Kohli comes out of the crease in search of a run. Pant is not ready and the Indian skipper has to charge back. The throw comes at his end and Kohli has to dive to make it in. Seems to have hurt his fingers in the process and the physio is called.
SIX! A left-hander against a left-arm spinner, always a delight to watch. Flighted ball on off, Pant rushes down the track and clobbers it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Flatter arm ball on middle, Kohli punches it off his back foot to wide long on for a run.

FOUR! Bludgeoned! A slower delivery, shorter in length, Pant fetches it from outside off and hammer-pulls it past the only fielder in the region at mid-wicket. He is inside the ring and there is no protection in the deep. A boundary to Rishabh's name. 12 from the over.
Play and a miss! A touch short and wide outside off, Pant swishes at it and misses.
Wide called for height. McCoy goes for the bouncer but it has gone way over the head of the batsman.

FOUR! What a shot! Poor delivery to start with, it's full and wide outside off, Pant reaches out for it and lifts it with good timing. It flies over extra cover and goes for a boundary. Good calculative risk by the young man. The fielders are inside the circle and there was no risk at all.
Kohli plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
A length delivery outside off, Pant walks forward and punches it through cover-point for a single.
Full and on middle, flicked in front of square leg for a run.
Obed McCoy loses his run-up again and pulls out. Last time when it happened, he picked a wicket next ball. Reload.
Another back foot punch by Pant, this time straight to the short cover fielder.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched off the back foot towards the bowler.
Short and outside off, Pant cuts but finds the backward point fielder.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short in length and spinning down the leg side. Pant stands tall inside the crease and hammers it wide of short fine leg. The fielder in the deep has no chance of cutting it off.
Leans forward and gently pushes it to covers for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, turned on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Shortish and outside off, cut through point for a run.

DROPPED! But what an attempt by Fabian Allen!!! Short in length and outside off, Pant rocks back and slaps it uppishly square of the wicket on the off side. Allen dives full length to his left, gets his hand to it but fails to hang on. Pant takes a single to get off the mark. Really an outstanding effort by the debutant. If you don't consider the dropped catch, he has stopped a certain boundary there.
Rishabh Pant arrives at number 5. Promotion for him? A wide first slip in place.

OUT! Rayudu drags it on! A wicket against the run of play. The line is too close to play the run down shot to third man. It's a touch short on middle and off, Rayudu opens the face but is cramped for room. End result, he has dragged it back onto the stumps. A disappointing end to a good looking knock. 149 needed off 146 balls. Can Windies create further inroads?
The bowler loses his run-up and pulls out at the last moment.
Angling away from the batsman, it's outside off, Rayudu opens the face of the bat but plays it straight to point.
Full and on middle, flicked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery around middle and leg, Kohli turns it off his pads to deep backward square leg for a run.
Obed McCoy is back into the attack.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a run.
Charges down the track and hammers it straight back. It deflects off Kohli to mid-wicket.
Goes back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. They pick up a single.
Walks forward and punches it back to the bowler.
Goes deep inside the crease and keeps it out on the off side. They scamper across for a sharp single. 11 from this over, 32 in the last three. Momentum shift as far as the scoring rate is concerned.
Slower this time, full and on off, Kohli flicks it to mid-wicket where the fielder fumbles and they cross for a run. Hetmyer was the culprit there.
Tossed up ball on off, Rayudu eases it with soft hands towards wide mid off and calls his skipper for a run.
FOUR! Better shot! Bowler under pressure. Flighted and full outside off, Ambati walks forward and lofts it over covers for a fabulous boundary.
FOUR! Poor delivery. Drops it short and down the leg side, all Rayudu has to do is to beat short fine leg and he does exactly that with his sweep shot. A boundary results.
Fullish and on off, driven back to the bowler.

SIX! This has gone all the way! Those wrists of Virat Kohli. Really made of steel. A flighted ball on middle, Virat latches onto it, brings his bottom hand into play and muscles it over wide long on for a maximum. 10 from the over.
Full and on off, spinning away, Rayudu drives it through mid off and collects a run.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched to sweeper cover for a run.
Slow loopy full ball around leg, Kohli tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It catches the leading edge and rolls through cover-point for a couple.
Beaten! Skiddy delivery, short and outside off, Kohli tries playing a late cut but misses.

Nicely adjusted. Rayudu gets forward to play it with a straight bat but seeing the ball skidding straight on, he opens the face of his blade and runs it past short third man. They manage to come back for the second.
Goes back to a short ball again and hits it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched down to mid off. The fielder was a bit deep and an easy run taken.
Leans forward and across before flicking it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Fine shot! The moment the ball drops short, Kohli pushes his weight deep inside the crease and pummels it over square leg for a boundary. 49th ODI fifty for the champion batsman!
Flighted and on middle, Rayudu drives it down to long on for a run. 100 up for India.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side, Rayudu tries to flick but misses.
Slow turn away from the batsman, Kohli cuts but finds the cover fielder.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended to mid-wicket.
Strides forward and drills his drive to covers. The fielder there dives and parries behind the bowler. Fabian quickly gets to it, no chance for a run.
Uses his wrists this time and clips it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Quicker and on off, Rayudu opens the face of the bat at the last moment and pushes it to point.
Flighted and outside off, forced back off the front foot but straight to the bowler.
Floated on middle, Kohli draws forward and mistimes his shot back to the bowler.
Lets the ball spin down towards leg and then eases it to mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy and full outside off, Rayudu drives it off his front foot but finds extra cover.
A long hop on off, Kohli goes back and pulls it with the spin to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on off, flicked across the line but straight to mid on.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched back to the bowler. Nurse fumbled but the mid on fielder made the stop.
Once again Fabian drags his length short and bowls it outside off, Kohli cuts it through point and picks up another run in this over. 5 from it.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Short in length this time, Kohli cuts it off his back foot to deep cover-point for one.
Very full and on off, it's driven down to long off for a single.
Full and on off, Rayudu prods forward and defends it close to his pads.
Flighted and on off, Kohli taps it down in the gap at cover-point for a brisk single.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Strides forward and pushes it through point for a single.
Gets back and hits it with the spin to mid-wicket.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Drinks break. Windies have managed to break the partnership. 196 more in the bank and they will have to keep picking wickets to stay in hunt. Ambati Rayudu has joined his skipper in the middle.

OUT! Given lbw! Another start not converted by Dhawan. Nurse delivers an arm ball around off from 'round the wicket. It skids on after landing and hits Dhawan on the pads who is down on one knee attempting a sweep shot. They appeal and the finger goes up immediately. Shikhar doesn't even bother referring it. This was that plumb.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it with soft hands to cover-point.
Around middle, shorter in length, punched back to the bowler.
Leaving the batsman outside off, shorter in length, Kohli guides it past short third man and takes a couple.
Tossed up ball outside off, pushed with soft hands towards cover-point for a run.
Quicker and on off, skidding in, Dhawan defends it from the crease.
Tickles it with the spin to the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched from the crease to covers.
Play and a miss! This one skids through the line after landing outside off. Kohli tries to play the square cut but is beaten due to the extra bounce.
Tossed up ball on off, punched down towards mid on. Dot ball.
Flighted and on middle, forced down the ground to long on for a run.
A slider this time. Landing on middle and skidding in, Dhawan tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Slower through the air, short and wide outside off, turning further away, Dhawan tries his best to play at it but misses.
Shortish and on middle, hit firmly past the mid-wicket fielder for a run.
Takes his front leg forward and forces it down through mid on for a run. Easy going for India in this run chase.
Tossed up ball on off, Virat gets on the front foot and defends it back watchfully.
Allows the ball to spin back in and eases it in front of square leg for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Stands back to a shortish ball and punches it through covers for a run.
Drags his length short first up, on middle, it's been pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Debutant Fabian Allen is into the attack.
Once again tries to find the gap on the leg side with his flick shot but fails. Tidy over by Ashley.
Gets back and flicks it with the spin to the leg side, finds mid-wicket.
Strides forward and plays it down with soft hands to covers for one.
Flighted and full on off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Goes back this time and picks it over mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, Kohli taps it down with the spin to mid-wicket.
Kohli opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shortish and on off, Kohli stands back and pushes it to the off side.
Angling into the batsman, Dhawan has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Even better! Obed overdoes his line and serves a length ball wide outside off. Virat leans well forward and creams it straight down the ground for a glorious boundary.
FOUR! Sliding down the leg side, Kohli picks it off his pads and nudges it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it to short extra cover.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Dhawan mistimes his punch shot through mid off for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Aerial but safe. Kohli tries to flick but is a bit early into the shot. It goes in the air but safely through mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish and on middle, Kohli goes back and works it off his pads to square leg.
Ashley Nurse to roll his arm now.
A pitched up delivery on off, driven off the front foot to wide mid off.
FOUR! And again! Obed once more offers room outside off and Dhawan shows no mercy. He gets on top of the bounce and powers it past the diving extra cover fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Width on offer outside off, Dhawan exercises his arms and whacks it through extra cover. Right through the gap it goes and reaches the fence in no time. 50-run stand comes up.
Very full and on off, Dhawan digs it out to mid on.
Serves it on a good length outside off, Dhawan taps it down from the crease to cover-point.
Angling down the leg side, Kohli tucks it behind square leg for a run.
Powerplay 2 signalled. Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be kept outside the circle till the 40th over. Bowling change as well. Obed McCoy to bowl.
FOUR! Nicely played! Holder bowls it a bit short and around off, Dhawan rocks back and punches it sweetly through covers for a cracking boundary.
Digs in a short ball on middle, Kohli walks across a bit and pulls it down to fine leg. It goes on one bounce to Roach in the deep and they cross for a run. 50 up for India.
On the pads and it's eased in front of square leg for a run.
Good length ball on middle, Kohli works it off his pads to deep backward square leg and crosses.
Strides forward to a length ball and pushes it to covers.
Kohli has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A length ball angling away from the batsman, Dhawan pushes it on the up but straight to extra cover.
Fullish and on off, Kohli walks across the stumps and bunts it down to mid on for a quick single.
Another nicely timed cover drive by Kohli but this time he finds the fielder inside the ring.

FOUR! Wow! Fullish and outside off, Kohli strides forward and drives it with excellent timing through the gap at extra cover and mid off. The ball finds the sweet spot of his bat with great consistency. 8000 ODI runs for Virat Kohli while batting at number 3.
On a length and outside off, Kohli taps it down from the crease to point.
Bowls this one from wide of the crease and slants in a length ball on middle. Kohli closes the face of the bat and helps it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Drifting down the leg side, Dhawan clips it off his pads but finds the short fine leg fielder.
Angling away from the left-hander, Dhawan makes an easy leave.
Bowls yet another delivery on the pads of Kohli, who this time nudges it to fine leg for a run.
Wide! Slips one down the leg side and is lucky that the Indian skipper doesn't get any wood behind it.
On middle, flicked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Kohli gets on the front foot and pushes it to covers.
Hurls in a good length delivery just around off, Kohli watches the line closely before making a leave.
Better this time. Allows the ball to come to him and then guides it towards third man for a run. He makes batting look so easy.
Bowls it on a length and outside off, Virat taps it down towards point. The way he played that shot, it appeared he wanted to tap and run.
Runs in hard and angles in a shortish ball on off. Kohli goes on his toes and uses his wrists to work it through square leg. An easy couple of runs taken.
Shortish and on off, defended off the back foot to the off side.

The line is too straight this time and Dhawan turns it with good timing past the mid-wicket fielder. The outfield is quick and the fielder has to really run hard to stop it before the rope. Kohli pushes Dhawan for the third run. Superb.
Back of a length delivery on off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Goes from 'round the wicket to Dhawan and serves a full ball on middle. The batsman pushes it off the inner half of his bat past his partner at the other end. A single to rotate the strike.
Fails to control his line this time and Kohli eases it off his pads to fine leg for a run.

Beaten! Excellent delivery. Not often you seen the Indian skipper get beaten like this. Holder bowls a length delivery outside off and it nips back in a bit after landing. Kohli is forward to push through the line but is beaten on the inside edge.
FOUR! This is the shot you pay to watch! As soon as Holder lands it full and outside off, Kohli transfers his weight onto the front foot and drives it crisply through covers. Delightful.
Good length delivery on off, Kohli remains on the back foot in defense.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and angling in, pushed out off the inner half of the bat to wide mid on for a run.
Slower one this time probably, a touch short and angling down, Dhawan tries working it on the leg side but misses. It deflects off his pads to the off side and they steal a leg bye.
Outside off, played down from the crease to point.

FOUR! Quality shot! Just gives this the direction with beautiful timing. Roach dishes out a good length ball outside off, Dhawan elegantly leans into the shot and pierces the gap at covers. Not stopping this one.
Roach comes from 'round the wicket and angles in a length ball on middle and leg. Dhawan works it off his pads but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Angling into the batsman, on a length, Kohli gets behind the line and blocks it solidly to the off side.
FOUR! Kohli is off the mark! He receives a length delivery on his pads and neatly deflects it to fine leg for a boundary. Just cannot bowl there to any batsman, forget Virat.
Good length ball on middle, turned in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Gets squared up. Holder bowls it in line of the stumps, getting it to straighten a bit, Shikhar tries to flick but it takes the leading part of his bat and rolls to extra cover.
FOUR! Wrong line and duly punished. Holder serves a full length delivery on the leg stump line, Dhawan picks it off his pads and whips it in front of square leg for a boundary.
Angling away from the batsman, a bit on the shorter side, Dhawan chops it down from the crease to backward point.
Wide! Way down the leg side, Dhawan has no chance of getting any bat to it.
Kohli chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump. Tidy over by Kemar.
A good length delivery on off, shaping back in, Kohli stays back and taps it down towards point.
Effort delivery. Roach bends his back and generates extra pace and bounce from around off. Kohli defends it off his back foot. The bowler is hitting the bat hard here.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
In walks India's superstar and skipper, Virat Kohli. He doesn't make runs nowadays, he makes records.

OUT! Right through him! Massive breakthrough for Windies. Holder provides it and jumps in joy. Rohit will have to go back after hitting a couple of good-looking boundaries. Jason angles in a length delivery in line of the stumps, Rohit tries to play with a straight bat but plays down the wrong line. The ball nips away ever so slightly to beat his willow and then knocks the middle stump down. Sharma was completely opened up there. Beautiful delivery. Rohit flops in his 300th international game.
A length ball just around off, Rohit stays back and taps it down to point.
FOUR! Glorious! A pitched up delivery outside off, Rohit uses his long hands to good effect. Leans into the drive and caresses it through cover-point for a boundary.
This time the line is too straight and Dhawan flicks it off his pads to fine leg. Gets off the mark with a single.
Identical to the last delivery, once again Shikhar stays back and defends it in the direction of the bowler.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Dhawan covers the line and blocks it down.
Jason Holder takes the second new ball from the other end. A slip remains. Dhawan will be on strike.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and safely keeps it out towards mid on. A decent start for India.
Good length ball around off, angling in, Rohit gets behind the line and defends.
On a length outside off, Sharma allows it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Sharma is off the mark! He has a gift of timing and placement. A back of a length delivery around off, Rohit goes on his toes and creams his back foot punch through extra cover.
A gentle delivery in the channel outside off, Rohit takes a stride forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Offers width firs ball. It's short and wide outside off. Sharma cuts it from the back foot but finds the cover-point fielder.

Back for the run chase. The players are back on the field. Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan are the Indian openers. A target of 284 in front of them. Can they provide a brisk start? Kemar Roach runs in with a slip in place...
